_comment: Pre-written answers for a SMALL build-from-design run (contact form) — a quick, clean golden run for the AC3 navigability trace and the Tier-2 promotion. Requirements come from the DESIGN in documentation/design/ (mockup.html, tokens.css, design-notes.md). Front-end only, one epic, one story.

intake.pitch: ContactPage — a single-page contact form. Build it to match the design in documentation/design/: one screen at / with Name, Email and Message fields (all required, email validated client-side), a 'Send message' button, and — on valid submit — a 'Thanks, we'll be in touch.' confirmation shown on the same page.
intake.roles: No roles / no sign-in — it's a public single-page form.
intake.signIn: None — the page is public, no authentication.
intake.dataSource: No backend and no API calls. Front-end only; the form does not send anywhere.
intake.styling: Use the design's tokens verbatim (documentation/design/tokens.css): primary #2563eb, Inter. Do not invent a palette.

designReadback._comment: Confirm the read-back at Intake; approve these.
designReadback.confirm: Yes — the single Contact screen, its fields, colours and copy match the design. Proceed.
designReadback.uncertaintyToConfirm: Where the submitted message goes is unspecified; there is no backend — it is not sent anywhere. Confirmed front-end only.

scope._comment: Keep it to ONE epic with a SINGLE story — a small, fast, clean run.

navigability._comment: For the AC3 navigability trace: which designed screen lives at which route. Used by unroutedScreens() over the built app's routes.
